items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Herbie introduced me and stuff like that... after Herbie spoke, I put my arm around it

ctx.x: And then he went to Algiers with his family. But he was through Memphis too, but not during my time that I knew him. That was a rich place to grow up, it was very very... and this last experience in Monterrey... They brought me back as a special, and Herbie introduced me and stuff like that, and they had a big statue of something like a award that they gave me. I didn't know how heavy it was cause after Herbie spoke, I put my arm around it, and I spoke for about ten or fifteen minutes and poor Herbie was holding…
